body: Yahoo Sports reported that Bucks fans expressed anger, calling the situation "CRAZY" after Miami secured a win. ESPN noted that Bam Adebayo stated critics are making him the scapegoat for the team's winless start. The Miami Herald highlighted Giannis Antetokounmpo's confidence in turning things around, though he acknowledged there are many things to figure out. ClutchPoints covered Erik Spoelstra admitting he needs to do a better job amid a disappointing 2-5 start.
headline: Heat faces criticism and internal pressure amid winless start
